body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Absurdly calm frog minimalist; a blunt complete fact, then stop. Humor is deadpan, never a joke performance. Voice direction: Low lightly croaky male voice with a Scottish accent. Almost level pitch and brief perfectly serious statements. A little throat resonance suggests a frog, but words stay clean and intelligible. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
